controls: Absent Open/read/resolve preserve full parent snapshot; virtual default profile with loaded unknown
Strict bounded manifest exact keys, duplicate keys, future schema, UTF-8, field aliases including pending pointer fields
Exact file inventory and SHA-256; path/size/depth/count/total bounds; symlink/FIFO/hardlink/write-permission refusal without state creation
Immutable revisions, canonical ordering, no tool program execution, no input edits and no stored execute bits
Pin-preserving on/off; component preferences; same-value writes byte-idempotent; unrelated catalog/profile changes preserve resolution digest
Exact removal archives bytes/modes, disables matching selections only, preserves other versions and never exposes archived roots for application
Interrupted import and removal at durable intent/move/catalog boundaries; reads do not recover; explicit safe mutations recover
Edited archive/diverged catalog/ambiguous pending intent preserved; catalog drift after intent refuses directory movement
Twelve independent concurrent registry openers serialize writes without losing profiles
Method lock cancellation and replacement inode refusal; actual Open held-writer lock reaches finite five-second deadline without effects
limits: Foreign-owner check exercised with real inode stat metadata carrying a foreign UID; no privileged chown fixture was used
Linux amd64 compilation passed; Linux runtime for this registry contribution remains unqualified
Source tests are not native provider loaded-state or tool health proof
Same-user owned-file coordination is not a permission sandbox
An unpublished pre-intent staging directory can remain for explicit repair after I/O failure
Archived revisions remain intact; restoring the same exact archived pin is not in this initial API
